A one-week tourist program in Kazakhstan It starts in the heart of nature in the city of Almaty, the cultural and tourist capital of the country, and the ideal place for Arab travelers looking for serene beauty and an authentic experience. Distinguished Almaty With its towering mountains, crystal lakes, and popular markets, making it a complete destination that combines relaxation and adventure. In this article, we provide you with a detailed schedule for a 7-day trip, in which we take you step by step to discover the most beautiful tourist attractions and activities that can be done in Almaty, with practical tips and recommendations tailored to the Arab traveler.

Arriving in Almaty: First Impressions

After arriving in Almaty, you will immediately feel the charm of this city that combines modernity and picturesque nature. Almaty is considered an ideal destination for Arab travelers, as it is distinguished by its wonderful location at the foothills of the Tien Shan Mountains, in addition to the moderate atmosphere and Kazakh hospitality that will make you feel at home. One of the first activities that you should start your trip in Almaty with is visiting Mount Tengerti, which provides you with charming panoramic views of the city and the surrounding mountains. The summit can be reached by cable car, which adds a touch of adventure and comfort at the same time. This visit is a great starting point to learn about Almaty's natural beauty. After exploring the mountain, you can head to the National Park in Almaty, which has many outdoor activities, such as hiking, cycling, and camping. Almaty's Markets and Local Cuisine

Once you are done with the natural activities, it is a must to visit Almaty's popular markets, such as Zielony Market (Green Market) where you can buy unique souvenirs, handicrafts, and local products such as spices and Kazakh tea. The markets here are a great opportunity to discover the culture of the Kazakh people up close. The Arcadia Tour team can organize a relaxing shopping tour in these markets. Read also: 5 reasons why traveling to Almaty is a great choice No visit to Almaty is complete without trying the distinctive Kazakh cuisine. You can head to one of the local restaurants in the city like Gulliver Restaurant or Tajine Restaurant for a traditional meal like manti (Kazakh dumplings) and plov (rice with meat). To provide you with the best experience, the Arcadia Tour team can arrange your reservation at one of the best restaurants serving authentic Kazakh food. Note: If you want to explore Almaty comfortably and without the hassle of planning, Arcadia offers you customized services to arrange every detail of your first day. From transfers, tours, to restaurants and local activities, everything will be meticulously organized for an exceptional tourist experience.

Kolsai and Kaindi Lakes

Kul-Sai Lake and Kaindi Lake are two of the most beautiful natural destinations that any traveler to Kazakhstan should not miss. The two lakes are located in the Kolsay Lake Park area in the southeast of the country, near the border with Kyrgyzstan, and are about 5-6 hours drive from Almaty. Due to the difficulty of reaching the place and its need for prior organization, Arcadia offers daily or multi-day tours to these destinations, including transportation in private cars with professional drivers and an Arabic-speaking tour guide. Tian Shan Mountains and Shymbulak Resort

The Tian Shan Mountains are considered one of the greatest mountain ranges in Central Asia. They extend into southern Kazakhstan and form a stunning panoramic backdrop to the city of Almaty. Frequently Asked Questions About Traveling to Kazakhstan

Is Kazakhstan safe for tourists?

Yes, Kazakhstan is considered a safe country for travelers, as tourists enjoy a welcome and reassurance during their stay, especially in major tourist cities such as Almaty.

Do Arab travelers need a visa for Kazakhstan?

Gulf citizens enter Kazakhstan visa-free for 30 days, and some other Arab nationalities need an electronic visa; see our Kazakhstan visa guide. It is advisable to check the visa requirements of your nationality before travelling.

Is halal food available in Kazakhstan?

Yes, halal food is available in Kazakhstan, especially in big cities like Almaty. Restaurants serving halal dishes are common, making the dining experience comfortable for Muslim travellers.
